Devolution Oversight: To strengthen fairness across the UK’s food supply chain and better support farmers and food producers, responsibility for the Groceries Code Adjudicator (GCA) will transfer from the Department for Business and Trade (DBT) to the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra) from 1 July 2026. Moving GCA sponsorship under Defra aligns the regulator’s work with the department’s wider role.
